description: Check whether a company fits this tool (micro-entity limits, single UK trade, no groups/R&D/gains/property). An overdrawn director loan is supported: the return carries a CT600A. Money in POUNDS.

filingTypes.description: What the customer wants to file. Only matters for periodOver12Months: a period of account over 12 months rules out a CT600 (which covers at most 12 months) but NOT a set of accounts, which Companies House takes for a period of any length up to 18 months. A first-year company normally has a period of 12 months plus a few weeks, so 'accounts' is often filable when 'ct600' is not.

name: check_ct600_eligibility
